notes.title: Prologue Update #1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! The team has pushed an update with minor fixes.

Updates:
- Some dialogue formatting issues
- Update localization corrections where other languages may appear
- Added saving options, now the game will save your preferences and load it as you start the game
- Fixed Roller Boulder sound and movement
- Fixed Sound Bugs on the introductions and other scenes
- Fixed game crashing on equip menu

Future Update Plans:
- There's been reports of crashing on the pause menu that could be due to limitations of the game engine we are using. We haven't been able to replicate it on our end. To permanently resolve the issue we'll be doing a Pause menu rework which includes inventory and equipment menu. This should help with anyone that is still encountering the issue.

notes.title: Prologue Scheduled to release next month with 5+ languages
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39012111/ee0d38a10f5137553a67bdfdf96dc47ff0f02694.png[/img]

[h1]Abyss the Forgotten Past: Prologue Release Details[/h1]

Hi everyone! We're super excited to share that we will be releasing the prologue for free here on steam the first week of December with 8 languages (and counting!) We can't wait to share what the team has been working on.

Abyss the Forgotten Past is a wonderful pixel 2D platformer with RPG elements where you play as Leonnor who sets out on a journey to discover everything about his past and his world. You'll learn special abilities, battle monsters, and encounter celestial beings as you explore this beautifully crafted pixel world.

We hope this prologue can give you an idea of what the team plans on doing for the full game that will launch as Early Access. We want to have a community-driven development approach towards Abyss. We want to work with the community to improve the game, get feedback, and see what the community would like to see for Abyss The Forgotten Past as we are working on it!

If you haven't already please wishlist the prologue and full game, it helps tremendously!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1369980/Abyss_The_Forgotten_Past/

[h2]Got a language request?[/h2]

Have another language you'd like us to add? Let us know in the comments, if there's enough demand we will try our best to add it!

[url=https://discord.gg/ARETB6qKkN]Join us on Discord [/url]to chat more deets about the game.
